about: Round 0 approves u1 and sends u2 to round 1. The migrator fixes u2 but also touches u1 in the record: first it rewrites u1's why, then it leaves u1 out. `record` refuses both (exit 1, one line naming the record file), as for an invalid record, because u1 isn't exactly as it was in the last valid copy. Nothing changes: the run stays at migrating, round 1, fixing [u2].
readings: A unit left out of a fix round's record counts as touched: 'exactly as it was' fails.
